about: DCInside projectcc (쿠키런 크럼블 gallery) posts on the Dimensional Rift (차원의 이면) for the 2026-10-07 round, window 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-07, captured in evidence/r2026-10-07/02-dc/dc (main-stage posts that turned up are included with scope 'stage' for the main-stage lane). Shape of evidence/08-extract/BRIEF.md; Rift attempts carry rift_attempt as in r2026-10-03/08-extract/dc-rift15.json. Brackets are computed from curated/rift-levels.json (season 1) against the in-Rift header power (the sword figure under the player name) only; power_basis 'rift' marks that figure, null means no header power was shown. Main-stage brackets use evidence/06-derived/stage-table.json. Cookies in battle bars were matched against crumb.gg's portraits (https://crumb.gg/cookies/<key>.png, viewed locally, not captured); '?' where the match wasn't certain. Stars are given as the image shows: gold stars are 1-5, each pink star replaces a gold one (6-10), so '9 (4 pink, 1 gold)' reads as 9 stars. The tool's comment fetch returned none for some posts; their comments were read from a separate page capture (<no>-page.html) and the summary says so. suggested_standing is this lane's suggestion.

posts.title_en: My take on crit rate vs crit damage
posts.summary_en: 전치: with full buffs, if crit rate without gear subs is around 50 more, take crit damage, otherwise crit rate; going from 603% to 650% (full-buff crit damage) helped. Comments (page capture): crit damage scales linearly with the number of crits (200% rate + 200% CD = two crits = 400%), measured in conquest. [comments from evidence/r2026-10-07/02-dc/dc/80904-page.html]
mechanics: Crit DMG applies per crit landed; crit rate above 100% gives multiple crits (전치, measured in conquest).
